name: Ore to Imouto no Kounai Play 2 ~Imouto wa Ore ga Otosu~
original_name: 俺と妹の校内プレイ2 ～妹は俺が堕とす～
source:
The morning begins as usual, with my sister who is a bit of a brocon
and my older sister who is overly concerned about me.
But that school life came to an end when my feelings for my sister reached their limit.

It all started when my friend confessed his feelings to my sister.
I just couldn't give in. So I took action.
I'm sure that would mean something to my sister...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1007732]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
早晨如往常一样开始，有一个有点兄控的妹妹和一个对我过度关心的姐姐。但当我对妹妹的感情达到极限时，那样的校园生活就此结束了。一切始于我的朋友向我妹妹表白。我无法忍受。于是我采取了行动。我相信这对妹妹来说一定意味着什么……
